entries.title: Rename a field in one embed
entries.summary: give a session or speaker field different wording on a public page ("Topic Area" instead of "Track") without renaming the field anywhere else. Click the ellipses button beside a selected field in the embed's field step and choose **Customize label**. Two embeds on the same event can show the same field under different names.

entries.title: Clearing a suppression lifts it everywhere
entries.summary: the suppression list now covers every blocked address your event is responsible for, including ones blocked by another event or by a system email, and clearing a block releases every block held against that person instead of only the one raised here. When the upstream provider refuses part of the clear, the confirmation names which list is still holding the address.

entries.title: Sending-domain health, rechecked on a schedule
entries.summary: organization **Settings → Admin** now shows whether your custom sending domain is still authenticated, when it was last checked, and which DNS records are failing. A domain that silently stops validating raises an alert instead of being discovered mid-campaign.

entries.title: Delivery history for automations
entries.summary: a new **Delivery history** tab in Automations lists every record an automation enrolled and whether an email actually went out, and keeps the record after the automation is deleted.

entries.title: "Don't personalize" really means it
entries.summary: a campaign test send with no record picked now leaves merge tags literal, instead of resolving them against a record Sessionboard guessed for you.

entries.title: System notification emails appear in Sent Emails
entries.summary: emails such as **New review assigned** are now recorded in **History → Sent Emails**.

entries.title: Help text on portal fields
entries.summary: write guidance under any field in a portal's **Manage Fields**, per portal, and portal users see it right where they fill the field in.

entries.title: Match session imports on your own ID
entries.summary: a session import row can be matched on **Client Session ID** as well as Session Friendly ID, and mapping an identifier onto the **Update session if already exists** switch now fails the row instead of quietly creating a duplicate. The award and interest import template's notes row is written in your admin language.

entries.title: Drop a standard speaker field from Grip
entries.summary: an event can now remove Mobile Phone, Headshot, or Biography from what it sends to Grip, so personal mobile numbers need not leave Sessionboard.

entries.title: Visit registration emails in the registrant's language
entries.summary: map a Sessionboard contact field to **Language (Visit translation ID)** and Visit sends its confirmation in that language. The Sync Results modal now also leads with the run's real status and the reason it failed.

entries.title: Reviewer recommendations and session builds in single-round plans
entries.summary: both settings are reachable in a plan with one round, not only in multi-round plans.
